title: Register normative classification rows for renumbered provisions B166-B171/C115/C116/D138 (alias A610-A617)
summary: The codex was renumbered into lettered domains on 2026-09-28 (provision_renumbering_registry). The eight provisions formerly known as A610-A617 are now B166 (infrastructure versions), C115 (Rust vector engine), B167 (JAX replaces PyTorch), B168 (native JavaScript), B169 (Go/Rust runtime), B170 (language-version table), D138 (test responsibility), B171 (test tools). All are lifecycle_state=active in provision_lifecycle_status, but the classification registries still carry zero rows for the new identities: provision_normativity_classification has none of B166-B171/C115/C116/D138 (verified live), and the parity gate test_five_category_parity_passes_on_live_codex fails closed on the same unclassified set. RUNTIME_RULE_INDEX_V2 denies the build with UNKNOWN_CONTROLLING_PROVISION:RULE_JAX_PYTORCH_V1:B167 because the rule's controlling provision does not resolve to a current-effective identity. Identical gap to the prior request, restated under the renumbered identities; the old-id rows would not be executable because the registries now key on the new ids.
